text: Probably patience and perspective more than anything. Older people have usually been through several crises — economic, political or personal — so they tend to panic less when things go wrong. They also know a lot of practical skills that are slowly disappearing, like repairing things or cooking traditional dishes without a recipe. Young people who listen to them can avoid a lot of unnecessary mistakes.

tips.en: Patience and perspective answer briefly, then the idea is developed.
tips.kk: Patience and perspective — сыйымды жауап, сосын дамыту.
tips.ru: Patience and perspective — ёмкий ответ, дальше развитие.

title.en: The key idea in two words

tips.example: Probably patience and perspective more than anything

tips.en: They have lived through crises, so they panic less.
tips.kk: Дағдарыстарды бастан өткерген — сондықтан аз абыржиды.
tips.example: they tend to panic less when things go wrong

questions.question: What can young people learn from older generations?

text: I think it should be their choice rather than something forced on them. Some people are exhausted after forty years of physical work and genuinely need to rest. Others, especially in intellectual jobs, feel healthier and happier when they stay active and useful. Part-time options would be ideal, because older employees could pass on their experience without the pressure of a full-time schedule.

tips.en: Their choice rather than forced is a clear position.
tips.kk: Their choice rather than forced — анық ұстаным.
tips.ru: Their choice rather than forced — чёткая позиция.
tips.example: it should be their choice rather than something forced on them

tips.en: Some people … Others … covers different cases.
tips.kk: Some people … Others … — жауап әртүрлі жағдайды ескереді.
tips.ru: Some people … Others … — ответ учитывает разные случаи.
tips.example: Others, especially in intellectual jobs, feel healthier and happier

questions.question: Should older people keep working after retirement age?

text: In Kazakhstan, the tradition is very clearly that elderly parents live with one of their children, often the youngest son, and care homes are seen as a last resort. I think that has real advantages — older people feel respected and grandchildren grow up close to them. However, when someone needs constant medical care, a good care home can sometimes offer better support than an exhausted family.

tips.en: The youngest-son tradition explains the local custom to the examiner.
tips.kk: Кенже ұл дәстүрі — емтихан алушыға түсіндірме.
tips.ru: Традиция младшего сына — объяснение для экзаменатора.

tips.en: However … an exhausted family admits the limits of tradition.
tips.kk: However … exhausted family — дәстүрдің шегін мойындау.
tips.ru: However … exhausted family — признание пределов традиции.
tips.example: a good care home can sometimes offer better support than an exhausted family

note.en: “The final option when nothing else works”.
“Have a close relationship as they grow”.

questions.followUp: What is common in your country?
questions.question: Is it better for elderly people to live with their families or in care homes?

text: In many families, grandparents have become almost essential childcare, because both parents work long hours. So in a way their role has grown. At the same time, grandparents today are often more active than in the past — they travel, work part-time or study — so they're not always available. I've also noticed that many of them now stay in touch with grandchildren through video calls rather than visits.

tips.en: Essential childcare explains why the role has grown.
tips.kk: Essential childcare — рөлдің неге өскенінің себебі.
tips.ru: Essential childcare — причина, почему роль выросла.
tips.example: grandparents have become almost essential childcare

tips.en: At the same time adds the other side: grandparents have busy lives too.
tips.kk: At the same time — екінші жағы: ата-әжелердің де өз өмірі бар.
tips.ru: At the same time — вторая сторона: у бабушек и дедушек своя жизнь.
tips.example: grandparents today are often more active than in the past

questions.question: How is the role of grandparents changing?

text: In personal relationships, I'd say yes, especially in Kazakh culture, where elders are traditionally given the best seat and the first word. But in public life, it's a different story. Many services have moved online without offering alternatives, and older people can end up feeling left behind. Real respect would mean designing cities, banks and hospitals with their needs in mind.

tips.en: Two areas of life, two different answers.
tips.example: But in public life, it's a different story

tips.en: Real respect would mean defines respect through practical action.
tips.kk: Real respect would mean — құрмет іс жүзінде түсіндірілген.
tips.ru: Real respect would mean — уважение объяснено на практике.
tips.example: Real respect would mean designing cities, banks and hospitals

questions.question: Do you think society respects older people enough?
